copy.subject: 想詢問一個小型、無費用的事實查核工作流程測試合作
copy.message:
台灣事實查核中心您好：

我是 Christopher Ongko，目前在元智大學就讀碩士班，也是 Nocturnal 的開發者。Nocturnal 是一個用來重建同一件公共資訊事件如何隨時間變化的研究工具：它不只保存單篇文章或公告，而是把最初資訊、後續更新、更正、爭議以及目前可確認的文件狀態，連同來源一起保留下來。

目前軟體與介面已經完成，我下一步希望做一個真正的外部工作流程測試，而不是繼續增加功能。因此想詢問貴中心是否願意用一個規模很小、無費用、由貴中心自行選擇的公開資料案例，測試 Nocturnal 是否真的能幫助分析人員更快重建事件的最新狀態。

測試只會比較幾個具體項目，例如：重建目前狀態所需時間、找到支持來源所需時間、更正或取代資訊是否更容易被發現、是否減少重複查找，以及分析過程中的錯誤或遺漏。這不是要請貴中心替專案背書；如果結果顯示工具沒有幫助，對我而言同樣是有效結果。

第一個案例我希望以非敏感、公開來源、且有明確更新或更正過程的事件為主，避免私人個資或懲罰性人物檔案。Nocturnal 的公開介面也不做真假、可信度、罪責或名譽評分。

若這個方向對貴中心有興趣，我可以先提供一份很短的 evaluator guide，並安排約 30 分鐘的示範，再由貴中心決定是否值得進一步做小型測試。

謝謝您閱讀。

Christopher Ongko
元智大學
s1133958@mail.yzu.edu.tw
copy.message_en:
Hello Taiwan FactCheck Center team,

I am Christopher Ongko, a master's student at Yuan Ze University in Taiwan and the developer of Nocturnal, an open research project for reconstructing how a public-source matter changes over time. Instead of treating each article or notice as an isolated result, Nocturnal keeps the first report, later updates, corrections, disputes and final documented state connected to the same matter and source trail.

I have finished the software/product side and am looking for one serious external workflow test rather than another feature sprint. I would like to ask whether someone at TFC would be open to a very small, no-cost pilot using one bounded public-information case of your choice.

The test would compare the normal workflow with Nocturnal on a few concrete measures: time to reconstruct the current state, time to recover supporting sources, visibility of corrections or superseding records, repeated checking avoided, and analyst error notes. I am not asking TFC to endorse the project, and a negative result would be just as useful.

For the first test I would prefer a non-sensitive, correction-rich public case rather than a private-person or punitive dossier. The public interface is read-only and does not generate truth, credibility, guilt or reputation scores.

If this sounds relevant, I can send a short evaluator guide and arrange a 30-minute walkthrough before you decide whether a pilot is worth doing.

Thank you for considering it.

Christopher Ongko
Yuan Ze University
s1133958@mail.yzu.edu.tw
copy.pilot_summary: One no-cost bounded public-source workflow comparison over a correction-rich non-sensitive case, measuring current-state reconstruction time, source-recovery time, correction/supersession visibility, duplicate checking avoided, and analyst error notes.
nonclaims: Do not describe Taiwan FactCheck Center as a partner before affirmative agreement.
Do not claim funding, endorsement or adoption.
Do not propose a private-person surveillance or punitive dossier case.
Do not claim Nocturnal produces truth, credibility, guilt or reputation scores.
